Every dot is a day someone bought AstraZeneca stock, 4,760 of them from 1993 to 2011. Red means that buyer is losing money.

One day later: 48% are red.
Ten years: still 696 red.

At 14 years 7 months, not one dot is losing.

The last red dot bought in February 1998 and was red for fourteen and a half years.

Every single person who waited made money.

Split-adjusted price, dividends excluded. Not financial advice.
